method: Frozen CAD section x=39.900037mm, horn outer edge sampled at <=0.1mm; compare in cup coordinates using logged relative angle. Translation drift and out-of-plane rotation omitted.
limitations: Only one shaft-normal section; tip curves and long/short arms included at this section
Outside distance is geometric section overlap, not a Rapier contact manifold penetration
Positive residual means collision reduction misses earlier CAD contact; results are illustrative and need collider refinement or physical clearance measurements
